title: Make Style cadence reactive in the Elementor panel
description: Fix the remaining editor issue where type-specific Style sections appear together or do not disappear until a reload.
objective: Apply Content-to-Style cadence immediately in the open Elementor panel while keeping hidden helper flags synchronized for saved widget state.
inputs_required: Guilherme report that Style sections appear together and do not react without reload
expected_outputs: Visible Content repeater rows are preferred as the freshest filter source
Style panel controls are shown or hidden immediately from computed filter flags
A follow-up sync handles Elementor delayed repeater updates
Content/Style tab switches trigger a fresh cadence sync
acceptance_criteria: Adding a range filter can reveal Range Style without editor reload.
Removing a range filter can hide Range Style without editor reload.
Option and rating sections follow the same panel visibility cadence.
Switching from Content to Style does not require waiting for a manual reload.
The change does not alter frontend filtering behavior.
verification: JS syntax check passes for assets/js/eit-editor.js.
PHP lint passes for plugin PHP files.
git diff --check passes in root and plugin.

budgets.context_budget: editor JS only plus local docs
budgets.research_budget: local source plus user visual report

risks: Panel DOM selectors are a pragmatic Elementor editor fallback and still need Guilherme visual QA.
The direct panel toggle should remain scoped to type-specific controls only.
